description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在通過對各種空間設計案例的分析和評估，探討空間設計的原則、特點和趨勢。通過深入研究不同類型的空間，包括住宅、商業、公共場所等，學生將學習如何從專業的角度進行空間賞析，理解設計師的設計思維和策略，以及設計作品背後的文化、歷史和社會背景。課程結合理論講解、實地考察和設計案例研究，幫助學生提高空間設計的專業素養和批判思維能力。
description.describe_eh: Analyze and evaluate various space design cases and explore the principles, characteristics and trends of space design. Through in-depth study of different types of spaces, including residential, commercial, public spaces, etc., students will learn how to appreciate space from a professional perspective, understand designers’ design thinking and strategies, and the cultural, historical and social background behind the design works. The course combines theoretical explanations, field trips and design case studies to help students improve their professionalism and critical thinking skills in space design.

targets.describe_ch: 理解不同類型空間的設計原則和特點，掌握空間設計的基本概念和技術。
targets.describe_en: Understand the design principles and characteristics of different types of spaces, and master the basic concepts and techniques of space design.

targets.describe_ch: 分析和評估各種空間設計案例，了解設計作品的設計思路、風格和特色。
targets.describe_en: Analyze and evaluate various space design cases to understand the design ideas, style and characteristics of the design works.

targets.describe_ch: 探討空間設計與文化、歷史、社會等方面的關係，理解空間設計在社會發展中的作用和價值。
targets.describe_en: Explore the relationship between space design and culture, history, society, etc., and understand the role and value of space design in social development.

targets.describe_ch: 學習從專業角度進行空間賞析，培養批判性思維和專業素養。
targets.describe_en: Learn to appreciate space from a professional perspective and develop critical thinking and professional qualities.

targets.describe_ch: 通過實地考察和設計案例研究，提高學生的實踐能力和解決問題的能力。
targets.describe_en: Improve students' practical and problem-solving abilities through field trips and case study design.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生對空間設計的興趣和熱情，激發其創造力和設計潛能。
targets.describe_en: Cultivate students' interest and enthusiasm for space design and stimulate their creativity and design potential.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1.每週上課請於09:30前依照課前公告完上課準備工作，如作品布置，準備投影器材……等!
2.出席依照正式課程原則處理，老師分上下午直接點名，遲到未請假將以曠課計之，直接影響平時成績，如遇不可抗力的因素務必提前聯繫告知，否則視同缺席。
3.課前課後請留意Messenger群組訊息，確保掌握課前準備工作，跟上課程進度。有問題隨時在群組中發問!
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Policies

Attendance
Regular attendance is expected. Two points will be deducted for each absence. Students who are absent five times will receive zero points for attendance.

Assignments
All assignments must be submitted on time. Late submissions may result in a deduction of points unless prior approval is obtained.

Participation
Active participation in discussions, exercises, and design activities is encouraged and will be considered as part of the coursework evaluation.

Academic Integrity
Students must maintain academic integrity. Plagiarism, cheating, or submitting work that is not your own is strictly prohibited.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1. 選組長，每週負責當週器材借還與準備工作，課後(17:00)監督同學進行場地復原的工作，並拍照上傳Messenger群組回報場地復原狀況。
2. 正式進度檢核(各週進度貼圖，正草，總評)未於規定時間完成作品佈置，視情節狀況扣分或直接喪失評圖的機會，不予計分。
3. 各次上課未輪到指導你的作品前，請利用課堂上的時間進行當週學習進度，或主動參與旁聽指導講評及討論。
4. 上下午課堂段全程參與學活動，離開教室請主動說明報備，切勿擅自離席!
5. 保持積極、專注、輕鬆、勤快、主動的狀態，避免不懂不問，進度拖延，缺圖少模等情事發生。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Friendly Reminder

Please bring your laptop and necessary software tools to class when required.

Save and back up your work regularly to avoid data loss.

Manage your time well and complete assignments progressively rather than waiting until the last minute.

Be respectful to classmates and maintain a positive learning environment.

If you encounter difficulties with the course, please communicate with the instructor early.
